speaker: Ms Carrie Tan
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) how is the space allocation for heavy vehicle parking lots calculated and decided for each town; (b) how often is this reviewed to ensure that there are sufficient lots to meet residents' needs; and (c) whether the MOM and the companies in sectors that employ lorry drivers are included in the review process to shift heavy vehicle parking lots away from HDB housing estates.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Residents have also raised noise and safety concerns due to heavy vehicle traffic arising from these HVPs.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: As the competition for land intensifies, it will be increasingly difficult to have HVPs in or near residential estates, where the tradeoffs are more acute.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Any injection of public HVPs in or near residential areas will need to be considered carefully.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We will continue our efforts to engage stakeholders from HV-operating sectors, like the private bus and logistics sectors.

speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
text: I would just like to clarify this: it looks like a multi-Ministry effort to review the allocation of space in Singapore for HVPs.

speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
text: And I am just wondering whether there is an expectation by the Ministries that employers need to be responsible for the cost of commute of the HV drivers to get to and from their residence to their parked vehicle, wherever that may be located, and whether this expectation of these commuting costs has been communicated to the employers of HV drivers.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: Some of these will be dependent on the specific sectors, for example, in the logistics sectors, buses for ferrying workers and passengers will be very different from sector to sector.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: And these are, indeed, the issues that we have been discussing with the different stakeholders.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: If there are specific issues or questions that the Member has encountered, please write to us.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: We would be happy to take a look at the specifics.
